name: helper-visible-sharing
goal: Every listed helper has at least two distinct component, service or model links in Used In, with eligibility and display using the same resolved consumer set

evidence: Previous Used In UI 5f3e02d7 exposed a mismatch: broad helperContract counts named-function consumers while visible links resolve only component/service/model unit ids. Ten actual cards include zero/one visible users. Align inclusion with that same visible set; no card design change.

Existing card SSR explicitly accepted a dash for zero visible consumers, and browser fixture only had one positively shared helper. Extend shared fixture with zero/one/missing/same-unit different-symbol cases, change the normal card assertion to exclude all below threshold, and retain two/three-user cases. Test typecheck and lint pass before freezing.
